title: 第10章 最好的朋友（中）
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林北一把夺过望远镜，朝悠悠指的方向望去。

好人？海贼世界的海贼，哪有好人？

“是亚尔丽塔海贼团。他们在朝我们这边靠，应该是发现我们了……准备战斗。”

悠悠瞬间来了精神：“那打败他们能拿到赏金吗？”

林北很欣慰，看来她至少没忘这趟是来干什么的。

“船长亚尔丽塔，是东海为数不多的女海贼，悬赏五百万贝利，换算成厄里斯差不多也是五百万。”

“五百万？！”

悠悠被这个数字吓住了。

在冒险者公会，赏金高达五百万的任务，已经是相当棘手的级别了。

“那他们一定很强吧？我们……有胜算吗？”

林北拍了拍她的肩膀。

“放心。早些时候，我之前待过的海贼团跟他们打过照面。他们船上都是普通人，没什么特别强的家伙。凭你的实力，很轻松就能解决。”

悠悠愣了一下。

“我的实力？林北先生你不出手吗？”

林北下意识摸了摸口袋里的冒险者卡片。

即便讨伐了五十只巨型蛤蟆，他的等级也才堪堪提到5级。

身体素质比起刚到素晴世界时确实提升了一大截，但要真刀真枪跟一整船海贼干仗，心里多少还是有点没底。

他轻咳一声，负手而立，义正词严，语气沉稳，面不改色。

“我可是经验丰富的大海贼，这种小喽啰级别的海贼团，还用不着我亲自出手。”

话锋一转，他把双手按在悠悠肩上。

“这是锻炼你在海上实战的好机会。作为我最好的朋友，我一定会好好训练你，把你培养成一名优秀的海员。所以悠悠，接下来的战斗，就全看你的表现了。”

他把“最好的朋友”几个字咬得格外清晰。

悠悠瞬间提起气势，一把抓住林北的手。

“你说我们是朋友，我还是你最好的朋友？真的吗林北先生？我真的是你最好的朋友吗？”

林北被她突如其来的热情晃了一下。

不过转念一想。

某种意义上，在素晴世界，他和悠悠打交道的时间确实比其他任何人都多。

说是最好的朋友，倒也不算违心。

毕竟，他也没别的朋友了。

“当然。放心，我会在后面保护好你的。”

Page (1/3)

Lin Bei grabbed the telescope and looked in the direction Youyou pointed.

Good guy?How can there be any good pirates in the pirate world?

"It's the Alita Pirates. They are moving towards us. They must have discovered us... Get ready to fight."

Youyou instantly became energetic: "Then can you get the bounty for defeating them?"

Lin Bei was very pleased. It seemed that at least she had not forgotten what she was here for.

"Captain Arrita is one of the few female pirates in the East China Sea. She has a bounty of five million beli, which is almost five million when converted to Eris."

"Five million?!"

Yoyo was frightened by this number.

In the Adventurer's Guild, a mission with a bounty of up to five million is already a very difficult level.

"Then they must be very strong, right? Do we... have any chance of winning?"

Lin Bei patted her shoulder.

"Don't worry. Earlier, the pirate group I was with had an encounter with them. They were all ordinary people on board, there were no particularly strong guys. With your strength, you can easily solve them."

Youyou was stunned for a moment.

"My strength? Mr. Lin Bei, won't you take action?"

Lin Bei subconsciously touched the adventurer card in his pocket.

Even after defeating fifty giant toads, his level could only reach level 5.

My physical fitness has indeed improved a lot compared to when I first arrived in Suqing's world, but if I have to fight a whole ship of pirates with real swords and guns, I still feel a little unsure.

He coughed lightly, stood with his hands behind his back, spoke righteously, his tone was calm, and his expression remained unchanged.

"I'm an experienced big pirate. This kind of small-scale pirate group doesn't need me to personally take action."

When the conversation changed, he put his hands on Youyou's shoulders.

"This is a good opportunity to train you in actual combat at sea. As my best friend, I will definitely train you well and develop you into an excellent sailor. So Yunyun, the next battle will all depend on your performance."

He enunciated the words "best friend" very clearly.

Youyou instantly raised her momentum and grabbed Lin Bei's hand.

"You said we are friends, but I am still your best friend? Really, Mr. Lin Bei? Am I really your best friend?"

Lin Bei was shaken by her sudden enthusiasm.

But then I thought about it.

In a sense, he did spend more time dealing with Youyou than anyone else in Suqing's world.

It's not against my will to say they are best friends.

After all, he has no other friends.

"Of course. Don't worry, I will protect you from behind."
